## Purpose

Display an SVG and return selected polygon or region identifiers.

## Capability IDs

- `svg.select`

## Requirements

- SVG asset available to MethodMesh.

## Supported XLSForm calls


**From `example_odk_svg.select.xlsx`:**

```text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='svg.select',input_svg_name='bodymap_black.svg',input_selection_mode='sequence',return_mode='flat')
```
